name: PBX homeobox 1
pathways: positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II

function.text: PBX1 encodes pre-B-cell leukemia transcription factor 1. Annotated molecular activities include DNA-binding transcription factor activity and DNA-binding transcription activator activity, RNA polymerase II-specific. It participates in positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II and brain development.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to congenital anomalies of kidney and urinary tract syndrome with or without hearing loss, abnormal ears, or developmental delay (autosomal dominant).

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include B-lymphoblastic leukemia/lymphoma; Myoepithelial carcinoma of soft tissue/bone. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.
